paragraphs.text:
Norman’s gruff cry becomes high-pitched as wounds rip open 
his face and scalp. He goes down in a bloody haze. You are the 
only one left, and your strength is failing.

Attempt a Regular POW roll with a bonus die: if you succeed, go to 
442; if you fail, go to 441.
